name: Paneer Tikka Bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp tikka masala and 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
½ cucumber, 1 tomato and ½ onion, diced
Mint chutney: ¼ cup mint, ¼ cup coriander, 1 green chilli, lemon juice, 2 tbsp water
steps: Marinate the paneer in the yogurt, tikka masala, ginger-garlic paste and salt for 20 minutes.
Roast at 220°C or cook in a non-stick pan with the oil for 8–10 minutes until browned.
Blend the chutney ingredients with salt.
Divide the brown rice between two bowls and top with the cucumber, tomato and onion.
Add the paneer, drizzle with chutney and serve with lemon.
note: A balanced bowl: protein, whole grain and raw vegetables.
